Term1: CAP INPATIENT TREATED SETTING NON-SEVERE CAP
Text:
## NON-SEVERE COMMUNITY-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA TREATED IN AN INPATIENT SETTING
Common alternative explanations include heart failure, thromboembolic disease,
COPD exacerbation, viral pneumonitis, aspiration pneumonitis, or tumor. Most of
the latter conditions do NOT benefit from antimicrobials.
## Duration of therapy
Patients with CAP should be treated for a minimum of 5 days, should be afebrile
for 48-72 hours, and should have no more than 1 CAP- associated sign of clinical
instability before discontinuation of therapy.
## Criteria for clinical stability
Temperature less than/equal to 100 degrees F Heart rate less than/equal to 100
beats/minute Respiratory rate less than/equal to 24 breaths/minute Systolic
blood pressure greater than/equal to 90 mm Hg Arterial oxygen saturation greater
than/equal to 90% --OR-- PO2 greater than/equal to 60 mm Hg on room air Ability
to maintain oral intake Normal mental status

## Stepdown empiric treatment for CAP (Intravenous to Oral conversion)
[Stepdown empiric treatment for CAP with oral antibiotics](orzc-gmenu-cap-outpatient-treated-setting)
Note: These regimens may also be used to convert patients to oral medications
prior to discharge.
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Inpatient

## Preferred
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h for 5 days [M] <AND> azithromycin 500 mg PO x1 on](orz-set-abx-pna-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-qd-and-azithromycin-500mg-po)
day 1, then 250 mg PO Q24H for 4 days [M]
## Prior respiratory isolation of MRSA within the last 12 months
ADD MRSA coverage to preferred regimen above or antipseudomonal regimen below.
Obtain cultures/nasal PCR to allow for de-escalation.
[< ADD > Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h [R]](orz-set-abx-vanco-pna-new-start-mrsa-nares)
## Prior respiratory isolation of P. aeruginosa within the last 12 months
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R] <AND> azithromycin 500mg PO x1 on](orz-set-abx-pna-piperacillin-tazo-and-azithromycin-500-250-po)
day 1, then 250 mg PO Q24H for 4 days [M]
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV Q8H [R] <AND> azithromycin 500 mg PO x1 on day 1, then 250 mg](orz-set-abx-pna-cefepime-2gm-q8h-and-azith-500-250-po)
PO Q24H for 4 days [M]
## Alternative
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg PO Q24H [R,DI]](psjzid2-pna-levofloxacin-750-mg-po-q24h)
